_comment: omen-kbd: merge the six entries under "hooks" into ~/.claude/settings.json, next to your existing SessionStart hook (add these keys to your "hooks" object; keep the others), and leave out this _comment line. Install the script first: cmake --install build --prefix ~/.local puts it at ~/.local/bin/omen-kbd-agent-hook. It prints nothing and always exits 0. async runs a hook in the background so it cannot slow Claude Code; it is set on the three busy events only; Notification, Stop and SessionEnd stay synchronous so the waiting, done and end signals keep their order.
